stem: Three identical boxes and one bag have a total mass of 19 kilograms. The three boxes together have a mass 5 kilograms greater than the mass of the bag. What is the mass, in kilograms, of the bag?
solution: Let \(b\) be the mass of one box and \(g\) the mass of the bag: \(3b + g = 19\) and \(3b - g = 5\).
Subtract the second equation from the first: \(2g = 14\), so \(g = 7\).
(Then \(3b = 12\), so each box has a mass of 4 kilograms.)
verify:
b, g = symbols('b g')
sol = solve([3*b + g - 19, 3*b - g - 5], [b, g])
assert sol == {b: 4, g: 7}
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [sol[g]]
